reviews.text: Got it for a friend who says she can't live without it. I haven't tried it because I am sensitive to niacin. She loves it though!
reviews.zh: 買咗畀朋友，佢話冇咗佢唔得。我自己未試過因為我對 niacin 敏感。不過佢就好鍾意！

reviews.text: Very light on the skin, like a super thin moisturiser for those days when it’s a little too humid that you don’t want to over burden your skin.
reviews.zh: 上皮膚好輕盈，似超薄嘅保濕霜，適合濕度高少少、唔想俾太多嘢壓住皮膚嘅日子用。

reviews.text: Light a refreshing. Perfect for summer or serum heavy days. If you’re extremely dry this would layer well with other creams
reviews.zh: 輕清爽，夏天或者已經搽咗好多精華嘅日子啱用。如果你超級乾，佢可以同其他乳霜疊搽得幾好。

reviews.text: It smells great and absorbed quickly. However it did nothing for my dehydrated skin.
reviews.zh: 味道好聞，吸收得快。但對我缺水嘅皮膚完全冇幫助。

reviews.text:
朝メイク前に使ってます。
ポロポロが出たり、寄れやすくなったりしないので良いです。
reviews.zh: 喺朝早化妝前用緊。唔會甩擦膠碎、亦唔易卡粉，幾好。

reviews.text: This is a wonderful lotion! My skin feels soft and smooth, like a baby's!
reviews.zh: 呢支乳液超正！皮膚摸落又軟又滑，好似 BB 咁！

reviews.text: i like it so thin and nice draws nicely and all love it had two gave one to my sibling they loved it very much too !! will try other colours
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意，質地夠薄又靚，好畫，大家都好鍾意。我有兩支，送咗一支畀兄弟姊妹，佢哋都好鍾意！！會試其他色。

reviews.text: Wow, the smell is so good and makes my skin feel fresh and moist.
reviews.zh: 嘩，味道超正，用完好清新又水潤。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
